page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.xlarge is an instance in the High Clock Speed family built on x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. Hardware resources include 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU allocation. It does not include local disk storage or GPU accelerators, relying on remote block storage and providing a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks show competitive single-core behavior alongside lower multi-threaded execution metrics. In single-threaded workloads, the instance achieves average results, including a stress-ng single-core score of 1430.09, a Geekbench single-core score of 1263.0, and single-threaded gzip throughput of 24.87 GB/sec. Multi-core performance is limited by the two-core physical topology, registering 3818.21 in stress-ng and 2777.0 in Geekbench multi-core testing. Memory performance benchmarks indicate an uncached read bandwidth of 26.36 GB/sec and a PassMark memory rating of 2138.06.

From a resource and cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides substantial RAM capacity without requiring the procurement of higher vCPU tiers. Tradeoffs include low baseline network bandwidth and reduced parallel throughput on compute-heavy tasks. The server is practical for memory-bound applications with moderate processing needs, such as in-memory caches, lightweight database services, staging environments, and intermediate data processing jobs.
